meta.name: TriliumNext Plugins — Official Registry
meta.author: ricolandia
meta.description: Personal plugin registry for TriliumNext Plugin Manager.

plugins.name: Weekly Planner
plugins.description: Simple Weekly planning board with Monday–Sunday columns.
plugins.author: ecodiv

plugins.name: Weekly Planner (Editor)
plugins.description: Weekly planning board with backlog and day columns, plus Month and Gantt views, recurrence, drag-and-drop and a mobile layout. Original version by ricolandia.
plugins.changelog: Datas locais (fim do deslocamento UTC), recorrências persistidas com travas #total/#every/#upto, scan global tolerante a falhas, teclado completo e i18n PT/EN.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Canvas Note Tools
plugins.description: Canvas toolkit for TriliumNext: note cards with in-place editing, relation types per arrow, longform synthesis, layered flowcharts from a text DSL (no arrows), #canvasTemplate insertion and built-in help. UI follows Trilium's language (PT/EN).
plugins.changelog: Rótulo da seta corrigido, groupIds remapeado no clone de template, JSON corrompido nunca é sobrescrito, editor com role=dialog + Esc, confirmações em 2 toques, launcher mobile com ARIA.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Canvas Templates For Production
plugins.description: 13 Excalidraw templates for productivity, learning, creativity and storytelling (OKR, GTD, Cornell, Feynman, Storyboard, Character Arc, Plot Timeline…). WCAG AA contrast, PT-BR. Ideal for use with Canvas Note Tools (Insert template).
plugins.changelog: Piso de texto em 12px (143 rótulos; 7 exceções medidas a 11px), raio de canto unificado por template, caixas ⬜→☐, 6 rótulos do storyboard recentrados; contraste WCAG AA e previews/SVGs regerados na rodada 15.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: FountainRenderer
plugins.description: Renders screenplay scripts written in Fountain directly inside TriliumNext. Supports scenes, action lines, dialogue, characters, and panel descriptions.
plugins.changelog: Fim da injeção em atributo (escaparHtml), atalhos escopados (não sequestram o zoom do Trilium), boneyard fora das estatísticas/PDF, sidebar e zoom/foco mantidos, i18n PT/EN.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Longform Compiler
plugins.description: Aggregates a subtree of notes into a single compiled document. Useful for book manuscripts, academic articles, and any long-form writing split across multiple notes.
plugins.changelog: Compilado sanitizado, ordem salva com toast só quando muda, cards com teclado (Enter abre) + botões ↑/↓, erros visíveis com retry, i18n PT/EN.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: AI Chat (OpenRouter)
plugins.description: Inline AI chat widget for any OpenAI-compatible provider (api_base), OpenRouter included. Conversation history, configurable system prompt and context from the current note.
plugins.changelog: Config encontrada pelo label #aiChatConfig (instalação nova deixa de nascer quebrada), renderização fail-closed, AbortController por operação, CSS escopado, i18n PT/EN (85 chaves).
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Minimalist Pomodoro and Time Tracker
plugins.description: A monochromatic Pomodoro timer widget with per-note time tracking and automated report generation. Built with zero external dependencies.
plugins.changelog: STOP só limpa a sessão com o relatório salvo, fim da inflação offline, relatório em tabela HTML com títulos escapados, recarga retoma a sessão, a11y completa, i18n PT/EN (30 chaves).
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Attribute Garbage Collector
plugins.description: Scans all notes in your TriliumNext database for broken relations, unused labels, rare attributes, and near-duplicate names. Preview and batch-delete them — deletions persist.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Shared Notes
plugins.description: Share notes between TriliumNext instances via invite strings: multi-reply threads, versioned snapshots, bidirectional replies with a return channel, endpoint validation and a bilingual UI (PT/EN) that follows the interface language.
plugins.changelog: Envio marca snSent só em respostas confirmadas; handler blindado contra entradas hostis (409/410); fetch com redirect:'error' e teto de 1 MB; i18n 70 chaves; E2E real em 2 instâncias.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Knowledge Dashboard
plugins.description: Full-page dashboard that audits your knowledge base for orphan notes, stubs, empty notes, old TODOs, abandoned notes, PDFs — plus a Dataview-like custom SQL query builder.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Kanboard Integration
plugins.description: Kanboard integration via JSON-RPC API. Syncs projects, columns and tasks.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Word Counter
plugins.description: A compact right-pane panel showing word and character counts for the current note, alongside daily and weekly progress goals (baseline + delta semantics).
plugins.changelog: Semântica baseline + delta (mede palavras escritas de verdade), contagem com entidades corrigida, storage v2 com migração e poda, barras com contraste corrigido + ARIA, i18n PT/EN.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Daily Note Navigator
plugins.description: Right-pane widget to navigate daily journal notes (days and month jumps) with read-only navigation and an explicit create note action.
plugins.changelog: Navegação read-only com ação "Criar nota" (fim da criação silenciosa), teclado escopado ao widget, datas locais com clamp de mês, i18n PT/EN (15 chaves).
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Mastodon Sender
plugins.description: Compose and post toots directly from TriliumNext with visibility control, content warnings, and current note support.
plugins.author: ricolandia
